mutable struct ResultsForSeed
    seed::Int
    inference_results::Vector{Any}
    full_fold_input::Any
    embeddings::Union{Dict{String, Array{Float16}}, Nothing}
    distogram::Union{Array{Float16}, Nothing}
end

function make_model_config(; flash_attention_implementation::String="triton", num_diffusion_samples::Int=5, num_recycles::Int=10, return_embeddings::Bool=false, return_distogram::Bool=false)
    config = ModelConfig()
    config.global_config.flash_attention_implementation = flash_attention_implementation
    config.heads.diffusion.eval.num_samples = num_diffusion_samples
    config.num_recycles = num_recycles
    config.return_embeddings = return_embeddings
    config.return_distogram = return_distogram
    return config
end

mutable struct ModelRunner
    model_config::Any
    device::Any
    model_dir::String
    model_params::Any
    model::Any

    function ModelRunner(config::Any, device::Any, model_dir::String)
        model_params = get_model_haiku_params(model_dir=model_dir)
        model = generate_jitted_model(config, device, model_params)
        new(config, device, model_dir, model_params, model)
    end
end

function generate_jitted_model(config, device, model_params)
    # JAX specific behaviour must be replaced with suitable Julia equivalent; 
    # placeholder for the JAX-trained network wrapped as a callable; 
    # actual call depends on model implementation availability in Julia
    return (rng_key, featurised_example) -> run_model(config, model_params, rng_key, featurised_example)
end

function run_inference(runner::ModelRunner, featurised_example, rng_key)
    # replaces jax.device_put and jax.tree_map calls
    ex = remove_invalidly_typed_feats(featurised_example)
    result = runner.model(rng_key, ex)
    # numpy.asarray and dtype handling, converting to float32 if bfloat16
    result = convert_results_to_float32(result)
    identifier = runner.model_params["__meta__"]["__identifier__"]
    result["__identifier__"] = identifier
    return result
end

function convert_results_to_float32(result)
    for (k, v) in result
        if eltype(v) == Float16
            result[k] = Float32.(v)
        end
    end
    return result
end

function extract_inference_results(runner::ModelRunner, batch, result, target_name)
    return get_inference_result(batch=batch, result=result, target_name=target_name)
end

function extract_embeddings(runner::ModelRunner, result, num_tokens::Int)
    embeddings = Dict{String, Any}()
    if haskey(result, "single_embeddings")
        embeddings["single_embeddings"] = Float16.(result["single_embeddings"][1:num_tokens])
    end
    if haskey(result, "pair_embeddings")
        embeddings["pair_embeddings"] = Float16.(result["pair_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens])
    end
    return isempty(embeddings) ? nothing : embeddings
end

function extract_distogram(runner::ModelRunner, result, num_tokens::Int)
    if !haskey(result, "distogram")
        return nothing
    end
    d = result["distogram"]
    if !haskey(d, "distogram")
        return nothing
    end
    distogram = d["distogram"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :]
    return distogram
end

function predict_structure(fold_input, model_runner::ModelRunner; buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true)
    println("Featurising data with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    featurisation_start_time = time()
    ccd = cached_ccd(user_ccd=fold_input.user_ccd)
    featurised_examples = featurise_input(fold_input=fold_input, buckets=buckets, ccd=ccd, verbose=true, ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date, conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations, resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps)
    println("Featurising data with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - featurisation_start_time) seconds.")
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structure samples with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
    all_inference_start_time = time()
    all_inference_results = Vector{ResultsForSeed}()
    for (seed, example) in zip(fold_input.rng_seeds, featurised_examples)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed...")
        inference_start_time = time()
        rng_key = Random.seed!(seed)
        result = run_inference(model_runner, example, rng_key)
        println("Running model inference with seed $seed took $(time() - inference_start_time) seconds.")
        println("Extracting inference results with seed $seed...")
        extract_structures = time()
        inference_results = extract_inference_results(model_runner, batch=example, result=result, target_name=fold_input.name)
        num_tokens = length(inference_results[1].metadata["token_chain_ids"])
        embeddings = extract_embeddings(model_runner, result=result, num_tokens=num_tokens)
        distogram = extract_distogram(model_runner, result=result, num_tokens=num_tokens)
        println("Extracting $(length(inference_results)) inference samples with seed $seed took $(time() - extract_structures) seconds.")
        push!(all_inference_results, ResultsForSeed(seed, inference_results, fold_input, embeddings, distogram))
    end
    println("Running model inference and extracting output structures with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s) took $(time() - all_inference_start_time) seconds.")
    return all_inference_results
end

function write_fold_input_json(fold_input, output_dir)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(sanitised_name(fold_input))_data.json")
    println("Writing model input JSON to $path")
    open(path, "w") do f
        write(f, to_json(fold_input))
    end
end

function write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir, job_name)
    ranking_scores = []
    max_ranking_score = nothing
    max_ranking_result = nothing
    output_terms = read(joinpath(dirname(@__FILE__), "OUTPUT_TERMS_OF_USE.md"), String)
    mkpath(output_dir)
    for results_for_seed in all_inference_results
        seed = results_for_seed.seed
        for (sample_idx, result) in enumerate(results_for_seed.inference_results)
            sample_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_sample-$(sample_idx-1)")
            mkpath(sample_dir)
            write_output(result, sample_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$seed_sample-$(sample_idx-1)")
            ranking_score = parse(Float64, result.metadata["ranking_score"])
            push!(ranking_scores, (seed, sample_idx-1, ranking_score))
            if isnothing(max_ranking_score) || ranking_score > max_ranking_score
                max_ranking_score = ranking_score
                max_ranking_result = result
            end
        end
        if !isnothing(results_for_seed.embeddings)
            embeddings_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_embeddings")
            mkpath(embeddings_dir)
            write_embeddings(results_for_seed.embeddings, embeddings_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$seed")
        end
        if !isnothing(results_for_seed.distogram)
            distogram_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$seed_distogram")
            mkpath(distogram_dir)
            distogram_path = joinpath(distogram_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$seed_distogram.npz")
            open(distogram_path, "w") do f
                serialize(f, Float16.(results_for_seed.distogram))
            end
        end
    end
    if !isnothing(max_ranking_result)
        write_output(max_ranking_result, output_dir, job_name, terms_of_use=output_terms)
    end
    csv_path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(job_name)_ranking_scores.csv")
    open(csv_path, "w") do f
        println(f, "seed,sample,ranking_score")
        for (seed, sample, score) in ranking_scores
            println(f, "$seed,$sample,$score")
        end
    end
end

function replace_db_dir(path_with_db_dir::String, db_dirs::Vector{String})
    if occursin("DB_DIR", path_with_db_dir)
        for db_dir in db_dirs
            path = replace(path_with_db_dir, "\${DB_DIR}" => db_dir)
            if isfile(path) || isdir(path)
                return path
            end
        end
        error("$(path_with_db_dir) with \$\{DB_DIR\} not found in any of $(db_dirs).")
    end
    if !isfile(path_with_db_dir) && !isdir(path_with_db_dir)
        error("$(path_with_db_dir) does not exist.")
    end
    return path_with_db_dir
end

function process_fold_input(fold_input, data_pipeline_config, model_runner, output_dir; buckets=nothing, ref_max_modified_date=nothing, conformer_max_iterations=nothing, resolve_msa_overlaps=true, force_output_dir=false)
    println("\nRunning fold job $(fold_input.name)...")
    if isempty(fold_input.chains)
        error("Fold input has no chains.")
    end
    dir_exists = isdir(output_dir) && !isempty(readdir(output_dir))
    if !force_output_dir && dir_exists
        new_output_dir = "$(output_dir)_$(Dates.format(now(), "yyyymmdd_HHMMSS"))"
        println("Output will be written in $new_output_dir since $output_dir is non-empty.")
        output_dir = new_output_dir
    else
        println("Output will be written in $output_dir")
    end
    if isnothing(data_pipeline_config)
        println("Skipping data pipeline...")
    else
        println("Running data pipeline...")
        fold_input = process_data_pipeline(data_pipeline_config, fold_input)
        write_fold_input_json(fold_input, output_dir)
    end
    output = nothing
    if isnothing(model_runner)
        println("Skipping model inference...")
        output = fold_input
    else
        println("Predicting 3D structure for $(fold_input.name) with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        all_inference_results = predict_structure(fold_input, model_runner, buckets=buckets, ref_max_modified_date=ref_max_modified_date, conformer_max_iterations=conformer_max_iterations, resolve_msa_overlaps=resolve_msa_overlaps)
        println("Writing outputs with $(length(fold_input.rng_seeds)) seed(s)...")
        write_outputs(all_inference_results, output_dir, sanitised_name(fold_input))
        output = all_inference_results
    end
    println("Fold job $(fold_input.name) done, output written to $output_dir\n")
    return output
end
